strongs_1890.strongs_def: the hair of the head (locks, as ornamental, and thus differing from G2359 (θρίξ); which properly denotes merely the scalp)
strongs_1890.derivation: apparently from the same as G2865 (κομίζω);

occurrences.bsb: but that if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? For long hair is given to her as a covering.
occurrences.kjv: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.
